en-US.name: GIF Factory
en-US.summary: Optional local MIT package of the GIF factory skill and five companions for stickers, lenticular cards, motion posters, signatures, film titles, article-cover palettes, storybooks and related styles. Scripts, fonts, templates, references, the 100 color cards and LICENSE are included. Example renders and preview catalogs stay at the pinned upstream and are not shipped. Python 3 and Pillow are required for common sticker export; FFmpeg is needed only for optional MP4 previews. No generative models or paid services are bundled.
en-US.description: Market-local packaging of WoYun520/gif-factory@e89003a4a6ca4fd0e9e39c8859851b58c82bc368. The installer copies only the skill content directory. Package version 2026.11.24. See UPSTREAM.md for the same-pin per-file manifest and exclusion reasons.

zh-CN.name: GIF 工厂
zh-CN.summary: GIF 工厂技能及其五个配套技能的可选 MIT 本地包，用于表情包、光栅卡、动态海报、动态签名、电影片头、文章封面配色、动态绘本及相关风格。收录脚本、字体、模板、参考说明、100 张色卡和 LICENSE。示例成片和预览图库仍留在固定上游版本，不随包分发。常用表情包导出需要自行准备 Python 3 与 Pillow；仅在可选 MP4 预览时需要 FFmpeg。本包不附带生图模型或付费服务。
zh-CN.description: 基于 WoYun520/gif-factory@e89003a4a6ca4fd0e9e39c8859851b58c82bc368 的市场本地包装。安装器只复制技能内容目录。包版本 2026.11.24。同 pin 的逐文件清单与排除理由见 UPSTREAM.md。

requirements.value: Python 3 and Pillow in a private environment for common sticker export.
FFmpeg is required only when using --preview to write an MP4.
Example renders and preview catalogs are not shipped; they remain at the pinned upstream commit.
No generative model or paid service is bundled. The optional lemo-opuscar skill is not included.
